user.title: Sign in to Oasis
user.description: How do you sign in to the Oasis app?

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Oasis again
reauth_confirm.description: Oasis's sign-in has lapsed. How do you sign in to the Oasis app?

email.title: Sign in with email
email.description: The email and password you use in the Oasis app. They're kept in Home Assistant so it can sign in again by itself when Oasis asks.

google.title: Sign in with Google
google.description:
Google sends the sign-in back to the Oasis app, so it takes one extra step.

1. On a computer, open Chrome, open DevTools (View › Developer › Developer Tools), Network tab, tick **Preserve log**.
2. In that tab, open [Oasis's Google sign-in]({url}) and sign in.
3. The page stops without going anywhere. In the Network list, filter for `code=` and copy the address that starts with `com.mixtiles.oasis://success?code=` (or the request's **Location** header).
4. Paste it here within a few minutes.

You can also paste a refresh token kept from an earlier sign-in.

data.sign_in: Sign-in address, code or refresh token
